Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC)

Engineering, procurement and construction under one contract, scoped to what each project needs. IAQ answers for the system working as intended.

Integrated Project Delivery

Complex facilities require more than technical expertise. They demand seamless coordination across engineering, procurement and construction to ensure every element is aligned from concept to commissioning. Through an integrated project delivery approach, IAQ combines multidisciplinary expertise, meticulous planning and disciplined execution to deliver facilities that meet the highest standards of quality.

Our EPC Capabilities

IAQ delivers EPC solutions through a multidisciplinary team of engineers, project managers and construction professionals. Our capabilities span the full project lifecycle, enabling efficient coordination and successful project delivery across complex industrial environments.

Why Integrated Project Delivery Matters
Enhanced Coordination

Improved collaboration between design, procurement and construction teams throughout the project lifecycle.

Reduced Project Complexity

A structured delivery framework that helps streamline decision-making and project execution.

Improved Schedule Certainty

Early planning and coordinated execution help minimise delays and improve delivery confidence.

Quality & Safety Focus

Consistent management of quality and safety standards across all phases of the project.

Operational Readiness

A lifecycle approach that supports a smoother transition from project completion to facility operation.
